runs in Node, needs @types/node, and must set skipLibCheck: true: the
Module Federation SDK's declarations do `import webpack from "webpack"`,
which does not resolve here and is not worth depending on to silence.
src/cywebHostSentinel.ts used to be listed here too. It moved into
@cytoscape-web/app-runtime along with the runtime plugin that reads it —
one definition, so the value the build compiles in and the value the
resolver checks for cannot drift apart.
